content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Customer Support. My name is Brian. I see you've reached out about some recent order activity. Can you confirm your full name so I can verify your account?
Yes, I'm Sarah Williams. I just saw an email saying an order was placed that I don't recognize. I think my child may have clicked something by accident.

Thank you, Sarah. I completely understand your concern. We frequently handle situations like this, especially with families. Can you also provide the best phone number linked to your Amazon account for verification?
Sure, it's 555-362-4810. Please tell me this can be canceled?
Absolutely, you're in good hands. I'm going to check your account for any recent suspicious purchases. To ensure your security, can you verify the email address associated with your account?
It's sarah.williams77@email.com.
Thank you for confirming. I do see an order placed earlier today for a tablet and headphones, totaling $720. Can you confirm if you authorized this purchase?
No, I definitely did not. That must have been my son or it's a mistake.

Thank you for clarifying. Per Amazon's updated security policy, when unauthorized or accidental purchases are detected, we must perform a regulatory verification. This helps to prevent fraud and ensures customer protection. I'll guide you through this process step by step.
Okay, but is there anything I need to do right now?

Yes, for your protection, we temporarily put a hold on your account and the order. However, to process the cancellation and refund, there is a mandatory customs and regulatory fee. This is a new requirement for high-value orders, and the amount is fully refundable.
A fee? I've never heard of that before. Are you sure this is Amazon policy?

I completely understand your hesitation. This regulatory fee was introduced by the Amazon Risk Management Department to comply with new e-commerce laws. We always refund the fee once the verification completes, and I will stay with you throughout the process.
If it's refundable, I guess I can do it. How much is the fee?

For your order, the required regulatory fee is $198. Our system accepts this through Amazon-approved payment options, like Amazon gift cards. This is the fastest and safest way to process the verification.
So I have to buy gift cards? Why can't I just pay with my card?

That's a great question. Due to the nature of these regulatory checks and to prevent unauthorized charges, only gift card transactions are permitted for this specific process. Don't worry, you will not lose any money, once the verification is complete, the full amount is refunded to your original payment method.
Alright, I just want to make sure this order is canceled and my account is safe. What do I do next?

I'll walk you through everything. Please purchase two Amazon gift cards, each for $100, either online or at a local retailer. Once you have the cards, let me know and I'll provide instructions for the codes.
Can I just buy them online and send you the numbers?

Yes, that's perfect. Once you have the codes, please read them to me over the phone, or you can type them here in the chat. After I confirm the codes in our system, the order will be canceled and the refund process will begin.
Okay, I'll purchase them now. Should I stay on the line?
Yes, please stay with me. It's important for your security. Let me know as soon as you have the cards.
Alright, I'm making the purchase now. I just want to get this sorted.
You're doing the right thing, Sarah. We take our customers' safety very seriously. Please let me know when you have the cards, and I'll help you with the next step.
I just got the gift cards. Do you want the numbers now?
Yes, please. Can you provide the codes from the back of each gift card? This will allow our system to register your verification and process the cancellation.
Okay, the first code is AXG5-7HRT-YZ29. The second one is PLKM-4WSD-RK83.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm entering the codes now. This will only take a moment.
Alright, I really hope this fixes everything.

You're in good hands. Once this step is complete, your order will be canceled and the refund will be processed back to your account within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can assist you with while we finish up?
No, I just want my account to be safe. Thank you for helping.
